description: This Java source file implements the 'ProvisioningEntriesReadPlatformService' interface with methods for retrieving provisioning and loan product provisioning data from a database. It includes various inner classes for mapping SQL query results to data objects, handling pagination, and constructing SQL schema strings. Key methods perform SQL queries to fetch provisioning entries, loan product provisioning data, and related details, with support for filtering and pagination.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntriesReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProvisioningEntriesReadPlatformService interface providing methods to fetch provisioning data and entries from a database, with multiple inner classes dedicated to specific row mapping and SQL schema generation.

classes.name: LoanProductProvisioningEntryMapper
classes.description: Inner class that constructs SQL queries and maps result sets to LoanProductProvisioningEntryData objects for loan provisioning data.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps result set rows to ProvisioningEntryData objects representing provisioning entry metadata.

classes.name: LoanProductProvisioningEntryRowMapper
classes.description: Inner class for mapping SQL query results to LoanProductProvisioningEntryData objects with detailed provisioning entry info.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryDataMapperWithSumReserved
classes.description: Inner class that maps SQL query results, including summation of reserved amounts, to ProvisioningEntryData objects.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryIdDateRowMapper
classes.description: Inner class to map result set to ProvisioningEntryData with provisioning history ID and date.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductsProvisioningData
methods.description: Fetches loan product provisioning data for a specific date, returning a collection of LoanProductProvisioningEntryData.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryData
methods.description: Fetches provisioning entry data for a given entry ID or date, returning a ProvisioningEntryData object.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of all provisioning entries, with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryDataByCriteriaId
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning data associated with a specific criteria ID, including related entries.

methods.name: retrieveExistingProvisioningIdDateWithJournals
methods.description: Fetches the most recent provisioning history ID and date where journal entries are created.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Fetches provisioning entries with filtering options based on search parameters, supporting pagination.
